messages:
nina_support: Escalation from enterprise customer running Android SDK v4.0. Intermittent behavior: client reconnects mid-stream and were seeing duplicate billing charges + final tokens sometimes not delivered. Customer provided pcap and app logs. s3 pcap: s3://redwood-support/pcaps/1768641120-android-reconnect-storm.pcap

sam_sre: Thanks Nina. Can you paste the trace/request ids and a concise timeline? Is this hosted or dedicated? Any mobile carrier involved?

nina_support: Hosted API. Example trace: trace=4fa9c7d2-7b2e-4f1a-9c9d-77ab9e0f1111. Timeline: 14:05:20 client opens SSE, receives ~80% tokens, TCP connection resets from client at 14:05:22, server emits final event shortly after, client reconnects immediately and resumes (resume_token present) but billing shows two billable sessions. App logs show immediate reconnect loop. Logs snippet below:

```
[2026-03-11T14:05:20Z] req=4fa9c7d2 path=/v1/stream accept=text/event-stream user-agent=AndroidSDK/4.0 resume_token=rt-9ab status=200
[2026-03-11T14:05:22Z] tcp_event req=4fa9c7d2 tcp=RST from client
[2026-03-11T14:05:22Z] stream_event req=4fa9c7d2 event=chunk seq=47
[2026-03-11T14:05:22Z] stream_event req=4fa9c7d2 event=DONE seq=48
[2026-03-11T14:05:22Z] client_disconnect req=4fa9c7d2
```

olivia_infra: Preliminary glance: looks like client-initiated TCP resets during an upstream 504 window (we've seen mobile carriers/proxies issuing early RSTs when they see slow downstream). Two places to look: 1) LB/edge idle/keepalive config and proxy buffering, 2) billing dedupe key and resume_token TTL. Does billing dedupe depend on stream close event?

ryan_devex: Correct — current hosted billing dedupe ties the invoiceable checkpoint to server-side close/billing_id emitted at the end of stream. If client closes prior to that checkpoint, a reconnect yielding another close will double-count. Options: a) surface billing_id in first event metadata, b) dedupe by resume_token (but token TTL is short), or c) server store ephemeral session id at accept and use that for dedupe. Also client-side mitigation: add randomized backoff before reconnect and wait a short grace window for the DONE event.

ops-bot: :bar_chart: Metrics snapshot: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/d/mobile-reconnects?from=2026-03-11T14:00&to=2026-03-11T14:20 — reconnect rate spiked from 8/min to 220/min at 14:05. Top CIDR blocks: three carrier NAT ranges. Avg reconnect interval 0.9s, peak concurrent reconnects 380. Incident INC-20260311-17 created.

sam_sre: For observability please collect: 1) full tracing header on repro runs (X-Trace/X-Request-Id), 2) PCAP + mapping to req ids (we have s3 path), 3) the edge proxy logs around the 14:04-14:06 window, 4) per-ip reconnect counts. Also set a short-term alert for duplicate-billing-rate > 0.05% over 10m.

nina_support: Repro curl I used (from mac to simulate behavior). Note the quick loop to simulate the app reconnects: 

```
# start stream
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=gpt-lite" -v
# simulate immediate reconnects (no jitter) using resume token
for i in {1..6}; do \
  curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-Trace: repro-android-1" -H "X-Client-Resume: rt-9ab" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=gpt-lite" & \
  sleep 0.6; \
done
```

pcap quick summary (tshark): frequent TCP FIN/RST initiated by client within 400-1200ms, server-side emits DONE but client often tears down the socket before application-level frame is fully processed. Several 504s observed on edge prior to reconnect surge.

olivia_infra: Immediate mitigation proposals:
- bump mobile resume_token TTL to 45s (current default 10s) behind a temporary rollout flag
- emit billing_id/session_id in the first chunk metadata so we can dedupe early
- change edge keepalive configuration for mobile UA patterns (increase idle timeouts) and check if any carrier proxies are truncating by inspecting TCP MSS and window sizes
- add metric stream.final_ack_lag_ms and tag by user-agent and route

ryan_devex: Client guidance we should give customer:
- add exponential backoff with jitter for reconnects (suggested base wait 300ms, multiplier 1.5, jitter +/-150ms)
- implement a short grace period (e.g., 200-500ms) to allow DONE event to arrive before forcing reconnect
- include resume_token and X-Trace header in reconnect attempts for better correlation

sam_sre: Next action items agreed:
- infra (olivia_infra) to canary resume_token TTL bump for Android user agents and verify no regressions (watch duplicate-billing-rate and reconnect metric)
- devex (ryan_devex) to prepare a small platform patch to attach billing_session_id in initial stream event and add stream.final_ack_lag_ms metric + alert rule
- support (nina_support) to coordinate customer app patch and provide repro run with full X-Trace header and the pcap mapping
- ops-bot to add temporary dashboard with per-customer duplicate-billing-rate and set alert threshold

maya_cs: I'll inform the customer of the proposed mitigations and request a quick app update for backoff + the repro run with the X-Trace header. I'll also request the exact device carrier info to correlate NAT ranges.

nina_support: Uploaded pcap and logs to the ticket and pinged customer for app update. Will kick off canary once infra signals readiness. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
